name: Neumann Series Expansion
definition: The series represents incoming radiance as the sum of light that has undergone 0, 1, 2, ... scattering events. Even with 0 scatterings, attenuation ($\mathbf{G}$) occurs.
summary: The Neumann Series Expansion solves the Volume Rendering Integral by summing contributions from light sources across scattering orders, operating directly on transport operators rather than sampling path geometries.
